overview.description: The RBB Fund Inc F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund (SGVA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is a fund-of-funds that actively manages a portfolio of investment-grade US Treasuries with ultra-short-term maturities. The fund seeks to generate total return while minimizing dividend and distribution payments. SGVA was launched on Jun 10, 2026 and is issued by F/m Investments.
